video_title: Lonzo Ball Gets Honest About LaVar, Big Baller Brand & His Biggest Career Regret

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball's biggest regret is taking control of his career too early
quotes.excerpt: I guess that would be my one regret, like taking control of my career earlier.
quotes.quote: I never went to any Nike deal, no Adidas deal. I never heard no offers or nothing. I was just doing what I was told really. I guess that would be my one regret, like taking control of my career earlier. Really I was just following my pops, just doing what I was told.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball reflects on his $500,000 rookie contract
quotes.excerpt: Half a million dollars for a number one show and where it was is not really that much money.
quotes.quote: Half a million dollars for a number one show and where it was is not really that much money.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball defends his father LaVar Ball's character
quotes.excerpt: He's been talking this shit since I've been into the world and he's not done anything different.
quotes.quote: He's been talking this shit since I've been into the world and he's not done anything different other than that. I never had no regrets. The way my pops was, I'm thankful for how he was. Honestly, I got to where I was because of him. I got nothing but love for him.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. introduces Lonzo Ball on Curious Mike
quotes.excerpt: Before he ever got to the NBA, he turned Chino Hills into a national phenomenon.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: Before he ever got to the NBA, he turned Chino Hills into a national phenomenon and eventually got drafted number two to the Lakers and played with players like LeBron James.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Man, welcome back to another episode of Curious Mike. We got Zo in the building.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on growing up with LaVar Ball's personality
quotes.excerpt: What you see on TV is no different from what we would see at home.
quotes.quote: What you see on TV is no different from what we would see at home. So to us, it's not a shock or anything. But sometimes when he first got on the scene, people were like, what the fuck? No way he's talking like this. He was just like that since I've been born.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball describes his simple childhood in Chino Hills
quotes.excerpt: Growing up was really just a simple life. Where I'm from in Chino Hills, there's not much to do.
quotes.quote: Growing up was really just a simple life. Where I'm from in Chino Hills, there's not much to do. It's a small town, really like a farm, a lot of land. You can drive, you see cows and shit. It smelled like cow manure when I was a kid. It's got a lot better now, but really just playing outside, playing in the backyard, playing football in the street.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball explains the Chino Hills basketball system
quotes.excerpt: The best way to explain it is like if you play 2K. You're trading twos for threes.
quotes.quote: The best way to explain it is like if you play 2K. You're trading twos for threes. We're down for giving up a layup and shooting a three on the other end wide open, uncontested. We're down for giving up a layup and you put your 5-10 guard down there to go try to battle with G on the post. But it's also like we're going for every steal and we're trapping every corner, no matter what. That's how we played.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his teammates at Chino Hills
quotes.excerpt: We had two centers in front of him. Both of them were seniors. One of them ended up blowing his ACL.
quotes.quote: We had two centers in front of him. Both of them were seniors. One of them ended up blowing his ACL at our thing. ACL, MCL, something in his knee. Blew it out. Boom. So he was done. Next center coming in. Mind you, this dude is like 6-9 and we got another one, Chaz, he's like 6-7, 6-8. This dude like runs away. He runs away from school, can't find him for two weeks. So that was some whole other shit that if we ever get into a documentary, we'll get into that story.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the difficulty of beating the Chino Hills system
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be hard to beat that system in a 32-minute game.
quotes.quote: It's going to be hard to beat that system in a 32-minute game. If you take the best teams ever, put them all together in a series, and you set the rules how they're supposed to be in high school and we set that, I don't know if anybody is playing to our capabilities for a seven-game series, for instance.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his development as a basketball player
quotes.excerpt: My pops, he wasn't really with all the skillful things with basketball.
quotes.quote: My pops, he wasn't really with all the skillful things with basketball. When I went to camps and shit, I couldn't do two-ball handling, I couldn't go to cones and go behind the back 20 times and do all that type of shit. But once we start playing fives and I was cool, how I grew up playing was literally just my pops. We would dead-ass shoot like 20 bank shot pull-ups left and right and then just start hooping. That was just how we were played, that's how we were taught.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the height of Big Baller Brand popularity
quotes.excerpt: I was probably the height of all the BBB shit and everything for real.
quotes.quote: I was probably the height of all the BBB shit and everything for real. I remember going to stadiums, I remember like vividly going to play the Mavericks in Dallas. I'm looking around, I'm seeing hella BBB shirts and I'm like, damn, this shit crazy.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his first major purchase after being drafted
quotes.excerpt: I went right to the store, I bought a Rolls, I went right to the Mercedes dealership.
quotes.quote: I went right to the store, I bought a Rolls, I went right to the Mercedes dealership, I bought a G-Wagon. I went right to the bank, put the rest in cash, felt like the man.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his relationship with his girlfriend
quotes.excerpt: She was just cool, easy to talk to. I was pretty quiet, especially with people I didn't know.
quotes.quote: She was just cool, easy to talk to. I was pretty quiet, especially with people I didn't know. And when I met her, she was, I was talking to her the whole time and it was just, really just easy to hang out with her. That's how it started. We were just hanging out.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his long-term knee injury struggles
quotes.excerpt: I've been feeling my knee since I was in high school, bro. All the time.
quotes.quote: I've been feeling my knee since I was in high school, bro. All the time. People always thought that was my swag wearing the little one knee sleeve. That was just to keep my shit some compression on it because that would help it. It just felt better like that. But I always had some type of shit with my knees, bro. I don't know what that's from, if I lack of stretching, you know, lack of, I don't know, we're playing on too much concrete growing up, you know, running a lot and doing shit like that.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the bone bruise in his knee
quotes.excerpt: I had a bone bruise and I had been having problems with bone bruises in my ankle before.
quotes.quote: I had a bone bruise and I had been having problems with bone bruises in my ankle before. So this wasn't the first time. And bone bruises are weird, bro, because you can't really like treat them. We were doing this thing, I don't know, have you done that, the PRP? It's like a shock thing. It's like shockwave. That hurts. I don't even mess with it because it hurts so bad. That just scarred me, bro. So I had to do that for my ankle to get the bone bruises out.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his career longevity
quotes.excerpt: I started high school 14, I'm 28 now, 14 years.
quotes.quote: I started high school 14, I'm 28 now, 14 years.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the reality of injuries in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It definitely takes the joy away from it, obviously, because you can't do what you want to do.
quotes.quote: It definitely takes the joy away from it, obviously, because you can't do what you want to do. I think everybody just faces that at some point in their career eventually. You know, everybody, age is going to get you. I mean, unless you're Bron. Other than him, like something's going to happen to where you start declining, you know what I'm saying? It's always going to be like, damn, I wish I could do this, I wish I could do that. But I never really live life like, you know, looking in the past and nothing like that.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his transition to media and podcasting
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's just going like that seamlessly, bro. Like when I had got hurt in Chicago.
quotes.quote: I feel like it's just going like that seamlessly, bro. Like when I had got hurt in Chicago, that's when I started thinking like, damn, okay, this shit really about to be over. So if that's the case, I can't just sit in my room and just pout. Like I got to do something. And I always felt like, shit, we've been in media, I've been talking in front of cameras, you know what I'm saying? And then an idea turned into a situation and shit. Me and Dimo were just touching on it. We started shooting that shit in my living room two years ago and transitioned now, seven-figure deal, you know, got equity in the company and and it's going and running.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his views on marriage
quotes.excerpt: I'm not in a really a rush to get married per se, but I feel like I live a married man's life.
quotes.quote: I'm not in a really a rush to get married per se, but I feel like I live a married man's life for the most part. If I take, I'm doing everything for you and you basically living with me, you know what I'm saying? This is like, what more do you need? I don't necessarily agree with that part of it, like why do I have to get a paper to just solidify that I love this woman, you know what I'm saying? I'm all with the wedding and shit, but I don't know. It's not that I don't want to get married, I'm just taking my time.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the importance of starting a business
quotes.excerpt: You got to just start. That's what I say. We got to just start.
quotes.quote: You got to just start. That's what I say. We got to just start. Now we got the label, we got G out of his deal, now he's with the label doing his own, we got our own, we're our own label now, doing our shit now. So like I tell him, you got to just start. So today was the first day we dropped and we'll see where that goes.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of losing KCP and other key pieces on the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: The fact that KCP is gone, the fact that they let KCP go. He's a vital piece.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: You see with the Thunder, the fact that KCP is gone, the fact that they let KCP go. He is a vital piece. You have to almost pick and choose which, and I knew. So they let us run it back one more year. The next year we ran it back, we lost to Minnesota in Game 7. The thing is we won the championship and then they let KCP go. They let KCP go.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: And KCP is a vital piece. He is important.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun's role and fit in the Nuggets starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: Christian Braun is a really good player. He moved to the starting two spot.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: So Christian Braun is a really good player. When we won the chip, he was coming off the bench. He was a really big part of that championship team, but he moved to the starting two spot. And the thing that made us so unique when KCP was starting was he was the defender that Christian Braun is, just as good, maybe better at that time. Very good defender, but he is a three-point threat. Not trying to drive, not trying to do anything, but catch it and shoot.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: That does a lot too to your offense because it kind of.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of losing Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: That was the beginning of our downfall. We still went Game 7 with Minnesota.
quotes.quote: That was the beginning of our downfall. We still went Game 7 with Minnesota after Tim Connelly kind of built Minnesota to try to beat us with the two bigs. Because then you put KAT on Joker and you let Rudy kind of roam. So they kind of built that team to try to beat us and they got us in Game 7. Then they let us run it back another year and that is when we lost to OKC in Game 7.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on his injury-plagued playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: I had a terrible playoffs because I had an AC joint grade two injury.
quotes.quote: That is when I got hurt. I was wearing the pad on my shoulder. My shoulder was dislocated and stuff and we lost to OKC in Game 7. I had a terrible playoffs because I had an AC joint grade two injury. It was like a three or four-month injury, but I am trying to play through it. I am popping it with the numbing stuff with a needle every game. I am trying to play through it, cannot lift my arm, but we lose and I played the worst, so I am like, okay, I am the one that is probably going to get shipped out.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ranking the best players in their prime
quotes.excerpt: The first three is Stephen Curry, Kyrie Irving, and Damian Lillard.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: The first three is Stephen Curry, Kyrie Irving, and Damian Lillard. And this is like prime Dame. Like the Dame is going and getting seven.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: I feel that, and I am a Dame fan, but I am cutting Dame. No disrespect.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball's preference for Stephen Curry over Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I am starting Curry and I am benching Kyrie.
quotes.quote: I am starting Curry and I am benching Kyrie.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball evaluates Kyrie Irving's skill set
quotes.excerpt: He has more skill than Kevin Durant. He has posts.
quotes.quote: He has more skill than Kevin Durant. He has posts. No one else is shooting the floater with the left from free throw line for game. That happened against us with the left. That was against the Nuggets. I am in that clip. When he shot that, I was like, what the fuck? Because I am going to the inbounder. They gave it to Kyrie and Joker forced him to his left. They had one second left and he goes off his right foot, but it looks so pretty.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. selects his young guards
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards, Ja Morant, and LaMelo.
quotes.quote: We are going young guards. This is in their prime up to this point. Anthony Edwards, Ja Morant, and LaMelo.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball's rotation for young guards
quotes.excerpt: I am cutting Ja. I am cutting Ja. I am benching LaMelo and I am starting Ant.
quotes.quote: I am cutting Ja. I am cutting Ja. I am benching LaMelo and I am starting Ant.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. recalls Ja Morant's playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: Do you remember when Ja played the Timberwolves in that playoff series and he like dunked on Malik Beasley?
quotes.quote: Do you remember when Ja played the Timberwolves in that playoff series and he like dunked on Malik Beasley and he was looking crazy?
